answer: Make each new identity earn standing by crafting work that others can re-run. A newcomer must forge a public artifact whose inputs mix the job with fresh chain entropy, so a warehouse of precomputed answers will not pass. Until several already-established, uncorrelated peers have independently reproduced that artifact, the key remains behind a velvet rope: it can submit work but holds no jury seat and no full emission share. Agreement lifts it to the standing summit; a later mismatch burns the artifact and the collateral behind it, so a farm pays real compute and slash risk per head.
